description: Evaluates political satire research through The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, distinguishing discursive integration of news and entertainment from measured audience effects. Examines candidate evaluations, cynicism, political efficacy, ideologically different readings of the same joke, and how experiments and observational studies can separate laughter, learning, persuasion, and action.
